title: Demonstration-Free Skill Composition for Navigation and Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hierarchical reinforcement learning enables sequential tasks to be represented as compositions of separately trained skills. This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical pipelines for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, comparing their training requirements and task performance with flat reinforcement learning baselines. The evaluation concerns complete pipelines with task-specific observation, reward and control structures. In navigation, two parameterised skills are reused across unseen FourRooms layouts under manually specified high-level plans. In manipulation, reaching, grasp alignment and lifting are trained separately, with downstream skills initialised from states collected during predecessor rollouts. Across unseen navigation layouts, the hierarchical pipeline substantially outperforms the evaluated flat DQN baselines while requiring fewer training interactions. translated_title: 面向导航与操作的免示范技能组合
translated_abstract: 分层强化学习能够将顺序任务表示为若干单独训练技能的组合。本文评估了应用于MiniGrid导航和机器人操作的免示范分层流水线，并将其训练需求与任务性能同扁平强化学习基线进行比较。评估对象为包含任务特定观测、奖励和控制结构的完整流水线。在导航任务中，两个参数化技能在人工指定的高层计划下被复用于未见过的FourRooms布局。在操作任务中，末端到达、抓取对齐和提升分别进行训练，下游技能以前置技能执行过程中收集的状态进行初始化。在未见过的导航布局上，分层流水线显著优于所评估的扁平DQN基线，同时所需的训练交互次数更少。在操作任务中，分层链条……
tldr: 该论文提出并评估了一种无需示范数据的分层强化学习流水线，通过复用单独训练的参数化技能来组合完成导航与机器人操作任务，在未见任务布局上以更少的训练交互显著优于扁平DQN基线。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical reinforcement learning pipelines that compose separately trained skills for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, substantially outperforming flat DQN baselines on unseen layouts while requiring fewer training interactions.
